name: At least one image is visible in the product gallery

steps.script: (() => { const main = document.querySelector('.gallery-main .main-img'); if (!main) return { hasImage: false, reason: 'no .main-img element' }; return { hasImage: !!main.src && main.src.length > 0, src: main.src?.substring(0, 80), naturalWidth: main.naturalWidth, complete: main.complete }; })()
steps.description: Main gallery image exists and has a valid src

steps.script: (() => { const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('.gallery img'); let broken = 0; for (const img of imgs) { if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth === 0) broken++; } return { total: imgs.length, broken }; })()
steps.description: No broken images in the gallery

businessContext: Images are the #1 sales driver — if gallery images don't load, customers cannot evaluate the product
